sourceProvenance.title: Oh! Que Belas Laranjas
sourceProvenance.edition: Independent Pianify notation of the traditional song also catalogued as Oh! que bela laranja madura; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional Brazilian circle song); modern recordings and arrangements are not bundled
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.
